items.title: Carved Gourd Pendant Ornament
items.alt: A flattened tan gourd-shell ornament has an open carved leaf design, a wooden bead and a burgundy hanging loop.
items.description: A flattened tan gourd-shell ornament has an open carved leaf design, a wooden bead and a burgundy hanging loop. An original gourd illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.
